theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} [AddCommMonoid α] [PartialOrder α] [IsOrderedCancelAddMonoid α] [ExistsAddOfLE α] [LocallyFiniteOrder α] (a b c : α) : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (Multiset.Icc a b) = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) := by
  induction on (Multiset.Icc a b) with x xs
  case empty =>
    show Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) ∅ = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b)
    simp [Multiset.map, Multiset.Icc]
  case cons x xs =>
    have h1 : x = a := by rw [Icc.eq_iff.1 (Multiset.Icc.eq_iff.2 ⟨x, rfl⟩)]
    have h2 : xs = Multiset.Icc a b \ {x} := by rw [Icc.remove_singleton]
    have h3 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (Multiset.Icc a b) = {c + x} ++ Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) xs :=
      by simp [Multiset.map, h2]
    have h4 : Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) = {c + a} ++ Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) \ {c + a} :=
      by simp [Multiset.Icc]
    have h5 : Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) \ {c + a} = Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b) :=
      by rw [Icc.remove_singleton]
    have h6 : Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) xs = Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b) :=
      by rw [h2, h3, h4, h5]
    have h7 : {c + a} ++ Multiset.Icc (c + (a + 1)) (c + b) = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b) :=
      by rw [Icc.add_singleton]
    show Multiset.map (fun x => c + x) (Multiset.Icc a b) = Multiset.Icc (c + a) (c + b)
    rw [h3, h4, h5, h6, h7]
